targets.rawSql: SELECT 100 * sum(cached_prompt_tokens) / nullIf(sum(input_tokens), 0) AS value FROM pipeline.pipeline_events WHERE event_type = 'llm.completed' AND status = 'ok' AND cached_prompt_tokens IS NOT NULL AND event_time_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND engine IN (${engine:sqlstring}) AND device IN (${device:sqlstring})

SELECT 100 * countIf(prefix_cache_hit) / nullIf(count(), 0) AS value FROM pipeline.pipeline_events WHERE event_type = 'llm.completed' AND status = 'ok' AND cached_prompt_tokens IS NOT NULL AND event_time_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND engine IN (${engine:sqlstring}) AND device IN (${device:sqlstring})

SELECT quantile(0.95)(ttft_ms) AS value FROM pipeline.pipeline_events WHERE event_type = 'llm.completed' AND status = 'ok' AND cached_prompt_tokens IS NOT NULL AND prefix_cache_hit = 1 AND event_time_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND engine IN (${engine:sqlstring}) AND device IN (${device:sqlstring})

SELECT sum(cached_prompt_tokens) AS value FROM pipeline.pipeline_events WHERE event_type = 'llm.completed' AND status = 'ok' AND cached_prompt_tokens IS NOT NULL AND event_time_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND engine IN (${engine:sqlstring}) AND device IN (${device:sqlstring})

SELECT toStartOfFiveMinutes(toDateTime(intDiv(event_time_ms,1000))) AS time, 100 * sum(cached_prompt_tokens) / nullIf(sum(input_tokens), 0) AS prefix_hit_pct FROM pipeline.pipeline_events WHERE event_type = 'llm.completed' AND status = 'ok' AND cached_prompt_tokens IS NOT NULL AND event_time_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND engine IN (${engine:sqlstring}) AND device IN (${device:sqlstring}) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Token-weighted prefix-cache hit rate over time

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfFiveMinutes(toDateTime(intDiv(event_time_ms,1000))) AS time, quantileIf(0.95)(ttft_ms, prefix_cache_hit = 1) AS hit_ttft_p95, quantileIf(0.95)(ttft_ms, prefix_cache_hit = 0) AS miss_ttft_p95 FROM pipeline.pipeline_events WHERE event_type = 'llm.completed' AND status = 'ok' AND cached_prompt_tokens IS NOT NULL AND event_time_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND engine IN (${engine:sqlstring}) AND device IN (${device:sqlstring}) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
